subject.title: feat(ios): unify chat and voice experience

question: Should iOS permanently remove the Talk destination and treat existing `talk` and `voice` launch aliases as routes into the unified Chat experience?
rationale: This is a deliberate user-facing navigation and upgrade contract change, not a narrow correctness repair; contributor proof can demonstrate the new flow but cannot select the permanent product direction.

options.title: Approve the unified Chat contract
options.body: Accept Chat as the single iOS conversational surface after a current-main refresh confirms legacy aliases and session-safe ownership still work.

options.title: Keep a distinct Talk destination
options.body: Retain or restore a dedicated Talk route if maintainers want realtime voice to remain separately discoverable and independently navigable.

options.title: Narrow the first landing
options.body: Land only the ownership and activity-safety work while deferring the root-tab removal to a separately approved navigation change.

recommendation.title: Approve the unified Chat contract
recommendation.body: Accept Chat as the single iOS conversational surface after a current-main refresh confirms legacy aliases and session-safe ownership still work.

likelyOwner.reason: This person was explicitly routed by earlier review automation for the unresolved product decision.
